## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-provenance-controls`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-provenance-controls -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `pointers.jsonl`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `README.md`
- `eval.yaml`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- `pointers.jsonl`
- `axis-live.jsonl`
- `inspect/__init__.py`
- `inspect/CHAINFACTS-SIT.md`
- `jobs/inspect_gspc_provenance_controls_uv.py`

[Current GSPC board](https://councilof.ai/api/gspc) · [Methodology](https://councilof.ai/methodology/) · [Verify supported signed records](https://councilof.ai/gspc-verify/) · [Corrections](https://councilof.ai/claim-maintenance)

Apply the licence shown on this dataset. Published by Council of AI — Council for the Safety of Artificial Intelligence, operated by CSOAI Ltd. Measurement is not certification; a mirror or package is not evidence of current board admission or benchmark leadership.

---

> **Mirror.** This is a copy of https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-provenance-controls at revision `fc494cf42830819d6d5e478085ce9c897cfd6e5f`, made 2026-10-01. The Hugging Face copy is the original; if the two differ, it wins.

# GSPC — provenance controls facts (ChainFacts)

- SWIFT census (live): https://councilof.ai/api/swift
- XRPL reader (live): https://councilof.ai/api/xrpl

**MEASURED financial/domain axis** (issuer-account / on-chain control facts, n=6). Not a model leaderboard. No accuracy, no fleet, no leader, no separation — measured is not scored.

Frozen bank on Hub. Live `n` and status are the `provenance-controls` row on `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`. **Not a certificate.**

Council of AI · CSOAI Ltd (GB, Companies House 16939677).


**Live measurement.** This bank stands behind the `provenance-controls` row of the live GSPC board: `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc?axis=provenance-controls` (family, kind, status and n are on that row, never typed here; the whole board is `GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc`). Measurement, not certification.
